headings.usage_rules: Use for all page titles, dashboard metrics, and large structural text. Letter spacing must be tight (tracking-tighter) to give a tech-gaming aesthetic.

body.usage_rules: Use for table data, logs, labels, and regular body text. Keep letter spacing normal.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use heavily for dashboard cards. apply 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10'. Add subtle inner shadow.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Active elements (live logs, slots, buttons) should have a soft drop-shadow with the primary magenta color (drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,42,133,0.3)]).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the main background. Use a fixed background with radial gradient from top right (rgba(255, 42, 133, 0.15)) fading to transparent.

components.navigation: Floating Pill Navigation at the top or side. Glassmorphic, sticky, rounded-full on individual active links. Include Discord Avatar, Username ('czr' as owner), and Balance pill.
components.buttons: Gradient background (primary_gradient), rounded-xl or pill-shaped, hover:scale-105 transition-transform. No flat colors for primary actions.
components.cards: Glassmorphic bento box style. Sharp inner contrasts but soft ambient drop shadows.
components.live_log_feed: List items that slide in from the top. Each log has a glowing left border matching its division (King/Slave/Russian) and shows brainrot name, image, price, mutation.
components.slots_tiers: Distinct visual cards for King ($5/h), Slave ($3/h), and Russian ($1.25/h). Show locked/available state clearly with frosted glass overlays.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid Protocol: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous padding inside cards (p-6). Tight spacing in log lists (gap-2). Do not cram content.

motion.page_transitions: Fade in with a slight upward translation.
motion.hover_states: Buttons lift up by 2px, borders glow brighter. Lists highlight with a subtle white/5 background on hover.
motion.live_updates: When a new log arrives, it flashes briefly with a magenta highlight before settling into the list.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on dark backgrounds has at least 4.5:1 ratio. Text over primary gradients must be white.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the log feed animations.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='discord-login-btn', data-testid='live-log-item').

background_ambient.description: Dark neon magenta ambient background. Apply heavy blur and low opacity to act as a glowing ambient backdrop.

clock_motif.description: Analog clock aesthetic. Use faintly blended into the background or as a dashboard hero graphic.

user_avatar.description: 3D gamer avatar for the user profile / discord login component.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS for all styling. Implement custom colors in tailwind.config.js.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for tech/gaming aesthetic.
Implement the 'Horloge Joiner' wordmark boldly in the header.
Do not use generic Shadcn cards without heavily customizing them to be glassmorphic and dark.
Use Recharts or Shadcn charts for the Statistics 24h chart (styled with magenta lines and transparent gradients).
Build the 'slots' page with premium-looking tier cards (King, Slave, Russian).
Implement the Discord login state. Assuming logged in as 'czr' (Admin/Owner) with balance and admin panel access.
Use Framer Motion for the live feed sliding animations.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component is located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
